title.target: xìn lǐ huà bù quán de dōngxī

pairs.target: tǎ wéi nà zhāng huà zhe dàbǐng de huíxìn , dìèrtiān cái jiāojìn yóudài .
pairs.english: Tavi put his flatbread-illustrated reply into the mailbag only the next day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维那张画着大饼的回信，第二天才交进邮袋。

pairs.target: tā zài bèimiàn tiān le jiē fáng zhuǎn wèn yě néng zhǎodào , zhīdào xìn wèibì gǎndeshàng yīwén xiān chūfā , biàn lìng tóng dù chéng shuōhǎo , ruò yǒurén wèn zìjǐ de zhùchù , bié zhào nà zhāng bǐng tú qù cāi , zhíjiē zhǐ gěi tā jiù xíng .
pairs.english: He added that the receiving office could direct inquiries too. Knowing the letter might miss Iven before departure, he also asked Du Cheng to give his address directly if anyone asked, instead of guessing from the flatbread drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 他在背面添了接房转问也能找到，知道信未必赶得上伊文先出发，便另同杜澄说好，若有人问自己的住处，别照那张饼图去猜，直接指给他就行。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de fēng bǐ qiánrì róu , yángguāng cóng gāojià jiān zhàoguòlái , zài jiē fáng dìshàng huàchū jǐdào huǎnhuǎn nuódòng de yǐngzi .
pairs.english: The morning wind was gentler than before. Sunlight through the towers drew several slowly moving shadows on the receiving-office floor.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的风比前日柔，阳光从高架间照过来，在接房地上划出几道缓缓挪动的影子。

pairs.target: xià róng cóng nánbiān huílái , biǎn pídài shàng zhān zhe qiǎnqiǎnde ní , xiān jiāoshōu tiáo , zài zuò dào ménkǎn shàngjiě xié .
pairs.english: Xiarong returned from the south, light mud on her flat leather bag, handed over her receipt first, then sat on the threshold to untie her shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 夏绒从南边回来，扁皮袋上沾着浅浅的泥，先交收条，再坐到门槛上解鞋。

pairs.target: tā jīnrì zhè fēng bǐ yuánxiān shuō de wǎn sòngdào , lùkǒu bǔ gōu de rén jiāng yíliàng kōngchē tuīfān zài pángbiān , rénrén dōu zhǐhǎo rào zhe guò .
pairs.english: Today's letter had arrived later than promised: ditch workers at the junction had overturned an empty cart beside the road, forcing everyone around it.
pairs.hanzi: 她今日这封比原先说的晚送到，路口补沟的人将一辆空车推翻在旁边，人人都只好绕着过。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiélǐ dǎo chū de shā fàngzài shǒuxīn , wèn tǎ wéi zhè suànbusuàn shāo huílái de huò .
pairs.english: She held the sand tipped from her shoes in her palm and asked Tavi whether it counted as cargo brought back.
pairs.hanzi: 她把鞋里倒出的砂放在手心，问塔维这算不算捎回来的货。

pairs.target: tā shuō ruò àn yílì yíjiàn , jì shīfu dàgài yuànyì tóng tā huàn huó . tā xiào le yíxià , jiǎohòugēn què mó hóng le , chóngxīn chuānxié shí méi xiào , fú zhe ménkuàng huǎn le piànkè cái zhàn qǐ .
pairs.english: He said at one item per grain, Master Ji might swap jobs with her. She smiled, but her heels were rubbed red; putting her shoes back on, she stopped smiling and rested against the doorframe before standing.
pairs.hanzi: 他说若按一粒一件，纪师傅大概愿意同她换活。她笑了一下，脚后跟却磨红了，重新穿鞋时没笑，扶着门框缓了片刻才站起。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng tì tā jiāng xià yìbāo názǒu , tā tái yǎn wèn ná qù nǎlǐ , tā yìshí dá bú shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to take her next packet for her. She looked up and asked where to; he had no answer for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想替她将下一包拿走，她抬眼问拿去哪里，他一时答不上。

pairs.target: tā biàn bǎ bāo wǎng zìjǐ tuǐ biān tuō , shuō jīnrì bú sòng le , yǐ tóng rén yuē míngzǎo , bié wèile bāngmáng xiān tì tā duō pǎo yítàng .
pairs.english: She dragged the packet to her legs, saying she was not delivering it today; tomorrow morning was agreed, so don't make an extra trip for her just to help.
pairs.hanzi: 她便把包往自己腿边拖，说今日不送了，已同人约明早，别为了帮忙先替她多跑一趟。

pairs.target: tā yào de shì zuò zhe bǎ xiélǐ de shā dǎo gānjìng , búshì duō yígè pǎo dé qìchuǎn de rén .
pairs.english: What she wanted was to sit and empty the sand from her shoes, not one more breathless runner.
pairs.hanzi: 她要的是坐着把鞋里的砂倒干净，不是多一个跑得气喘的人。

pairs.target: wǔhòu , diànlǐ sònglái liǎngfēng zhuǎn jìxìn . sè lā nà fēng xiě dé duǎn , shuō shōudào tā bào dào fēng zhàn de píngān xìn , liú zhe de xīn zhēn zhèhuí zhōngyú méi bèi tā fàngdào wàngjì .
pairs.english: That afternoon the shop brought two forwarded letters. Sela's was short: she had received his safe-arrival note from Wind Trestle and, this time, had finally remembered where she kept the new needles.
pairs.hanzi: 午后，店里送来两封转寄信。瑟拉那封写得短，说收到他报到风栈的平安信，留着的新针这回终于没被她放到忘记。

pairs.target: gébì sònglái yíjiàn xiùzǐ gǎi zhǎi de yīshang , tā yìshí jì chà , chàdiǎn àn tǎ wéi cóngqián de shǒubì gǎi , hǎo zài bù méi jiǎnxiàqù , biàn jiào rénjiā zài lái shēn yìhuí shǒu .
pairs.english: A neighbor brought clothes needing narrower sleeves; she mixed things up and nearly used Tavi's old arm size. Fortunately she had not cut the cloth, so called the owner back for another fitting.
pairs.hanzi: 隔壁送来一件袖子改窄的衣裳，她一时记岔，差点按塔维从前的手臂改，好在布没剪下去，便叫人家再来伸一回手。

pairs.target: tā méi shuō pàn tā mǎshàng huíqù , zhī wèn zhù de wūlòu bu lòufēng , bèizi liàng dé kāi me , bié zài xìn shàng guāng xiě dào le , yě xiě jǐjiàn néng jiào zìjǐ xiǎng dé chūlái de shì .
pairs.english: She did not ask him to hurry home, only whether his room was drafty and he could air his quilt. Don't just write “arrived”; tell her a few things she could picture.
pairs.hanzi: 她没说盼他马上回去，只问住的屋漏不漏风，被子晾得开么，别在信上光写到了，也写几件能叫自己想得出来的事。

pairs.target: zhǐ mò shuō wū yà hái méi lìng láixìn , jiù xìn réng fàng yuánchù , tā méiyǒu tì tā nágěi mǎn yuànzi de rén kàn .
pairs.english: At the end she said no further letter had come from Wuya. The old letter was still in its place; she had not shown it to everyone in the yard for him.
pairs.hanzi: 纸末说乌娅还没另来信，旧信仍放原处，她没有替他拿给满院子的人看。

pairs.target: nài lěi de xìn cháng yìdiǎn , zhǐ shàng dài zhe yìxiǎo dào bèi shuǐ yīn kāi de huī . tā zhèngzài xīmiàn de yìlù tìrén hé jǐchù gǎiguò de dùkǒu , huíxìn chí le liǎngtiān .
pairs.english: Nerai's was longer, with a small water-blurred gray streak on the paper. She was checking altered ferry crossings for a client on the western post roads and had replied two days late.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的信长一点，纸上带着一小道被水洇开的灰。她正在西面的驿路替人核几处改过的渡口，回信迟了两天。

pairs.target: tīng tā shuō tái jǐng nàzhǎn chuán dēng , tā zài pángbiān huà le liǎnggè bìng bù yuán de huán , shuō ruò zhī jì dēnghuì huàng , xiàhuí huàn yìtiáo chuán , zìjǐ yě wèibì rènde chūlái .
pairs.english: Reading about the Moss Well boat lamp, she drew two imperfect circles beside it, saying if all he remembered was that it swung, a different boat next time might leave even her unable to recognize it.
pairs.hanzi: 听他说苔井那盏船灯，她在旁边画了两个并不圆的环，说若只记灯会晃，下回换一条船，自己也未必认得出来。

pairs.target: tā yánzhe tā huà de huán kàn , hūrán xiǎngqǐ wēn xiù jiào zìjǐ bié zhī jì dǐxià de huán , rěnbúzhù jiāng liǎngzhāng zhǐ fàngdào yíkuài .
pairs.english: Following her drawn circles, he suddenly remembered Wenxiu telling him not to record only the ring below, and could not resist putting the two sheets together.
pairs.hanzi: 他沿着她画的环看，忽然想起温岫叫自己别只记底下的环，忍不住将两张纸放到一块。

pairs.target: nài lěi jiēzhe shuō , huàn yíjì zài zǒu , tā xiān dǎtīng shuǐlù yǔ huíchéng xiējiǎo chù , yóuqí wèn zhù zài nàér de rén zuórì zěnyàng zǒu , bù xiān ná jiù tú tóng rén zhēng nǎlǐ yīnggāi yǒu lù .
pairs.english: Nerai went on: in another season she first asked about water crossings and return resting places, especially how residents had traveled yesterday, rather than arguing from an old map where a road ought to be.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾接着说，换一季再走，她先打听水路与回程歇脚处，尤其问住在那儿的人昨日怎样走，不先拿旧图同人争哪里应该有路。

pairs.target: tā bìng méiyǒu xiě měi yíbù zěnyàng kàn . yǒu yíduàn fǎndǎo jiǎng zìjǐ zǎonián dài rén zǒu dào yígè yǒu dǐng de xiējiǎo péng , cái zhīdào dǐng yǐjīng ràng rén chāi huíjiā bǔ wū , yìxíng rén dǐng zhe yǔ chī le bàn dùn lěng fàn .
pairs.english: She did not explain every step. Instead one passage told of leading people to a roofed shelter years ago, only to find the roof removed to repair someone's house; the party ate half a cold meal in the rain.
pairs.hanzi: 她并没有写每一步怎样看。有一段反倒讲自己早年带人走到一个有顶的歇脚棚，才知道顶已经让人拆回家补屋，一行人顶着雨吃了半顿冷饭。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān huà de shì péng , hòulái yòu huà rénjiā wūdǐng , zǒng bùnéng zài tú shàng yāoqiú nà jiārén bǎ wūzi chāi gěi zìjǐ duǒyǔ .
pairs.english: She had drawn the shelter first, then the household roof; she could hardly demand on a map that they dismantle their home to shelter her from rain.
pairs.hanzi: 她原先画的是棚，后来又画人家屋顶，总不能在图上要求那家人把屋子拆给自己躲雨。

pairs.target: xìnmò , tā wèn tǎ wéi shìfǒu hái xiǎng zài zǒu yíduàn cháng xiē de suíxíng huì jì .
pairs.english: At the end she asked whether Tavi still wanted a longer trip doing accompanying sketches and notes.
pairs.hanzi: 信末，她问塔维是否还想再走一段长些的随行绘记。

pairs.target: tā yǒu yìtiáo zhīxiàn de hé lù chāishì shàng zài shāngliáng , ruò shírì néng hé , yào xiān yǔ tā de dàibān rén hé xuégōng shuō qīng , búshì jiào tā shōudào xìn biàn gēn chūqù , yě búshì bǎ yìzhāng bái pái jiègěi tā dài .
pairs.english: A side-route survey job was still under discussion. If dates matched, arrangements had to be clear with his supervisor and academy first, rather than his leaving on receipt or borrowing her white tally to wear.
pairs.hanzi: 她有一条支线的核路差事尚在商量，若时日能合，要先与他的带班人和学宫说清，不是叫他收到信便跟出去，也不是把一张白牌借给他戴。

pairs.target: tā ruò yuànyì , xiān bǎ tái jǐng wǎngfǎn de tíngxiē chù hé zìjǐ gǎiguò de pànduàn huà quán jì lái .
pairs.english: If willing, he should first send a complete drawing of the Moss Well round trip's stops and his revised judgments.
pairs.hanzi: 他若愿意，先把苔井往返的停歇处和自己改过的判断画全寄来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xìn dú le liǎngbiàn , méiyǒu xiān pǎo qù zhǎo ruǎn héng . tā tuīkāi chuāng , wǎng zhèn wài kàn le yíhuìer , cái jiāng tái jǐng nà zhāng tú pūkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi read twice without first running to Ruan Heng. He opened the window, looked beyond town for a while, then spread his Moss Well map.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将信读了两遍，没有先跑去找阮衡。他推开窗，往镇外看了一会儿，才将苔井那张图铺开。

pairs.target: zìjǐ zài shù páng huà guò yìzhī niǎo , méizǐ pù dǎo xiě dé hěndà , xiē guò jiǎo de yīnliángchù zhǐyǒu liǎnggè xiǎodiǎn , ruò yóu lìng yígè rén ná qù , kǒngpà hái méi děng zǒu wán , biàn xiān zhǎo cuò le chī méizǐ de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He had drawn a bird beside a tree and made the plum shop very large, but his shaded resting place was just two dots. Someone else might find the wrong plum-eating spot before finishing the walk.
pairs.hanzi: 自己在树旁画过一只鸟，梅子铺倒写得很大，歇过脚的阴凉处只有两个小点，若由另一个人拿去，恐怕还没等走完，便先找错了吃梅子的地方。

pairs.target: tā huà dào bànjié , xià róng lái ná liúzài ménbiān de bāo , qiáojiàn tú , wèn nà yìtuán shìbushì zìjǐ zài shuǐcáo biān zuò de shítou .
pairs.english: Halfway through drawing, Xiarong came for the packet by the door, saw the map and asked if that blob was the stone she sat on beside the trough.
pairs.hanzi: 他画到半截，夏绒来拿留在门边的包，瞧见图，问那一团是不是自己在水槽边坐的石头。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , tā shuō nà kuàishí xiàyǔ huì huá , zìjǐ zhī zài qíngtiān zuò , jiào tā bié gěi méi zǒuguò de rén huà chéng sìjì dōu néng tǎng de chuáng .
pairs.english: He nodded. She said the stone was slippery in rain and she sat there only in sunshine; don't draw it as a year-round bed for people who had never walked there.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，她说那块石下雨会滑，自己只在晴天坐，叫他别给没走过的人画成四季都能躺的床。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn zǒu , méi liúxiàlái jiào tā huà . tǎ wéi jiāng qíngtiān liǎnggè zì tiān zài pángbiān , yòu jiāng zhèhuà zhào yuányì jìxià , méiyǒu tì tā bǔ yígè shuí dōu méi shì guò de yǔtiān zǒufǎ .
pairs.english: She left without staying to teach drawing. Tavi added “sunshine” beside it and recorded what she had meant, without inventing a rainy-day route nobody had tested.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完便走，没留下来教他画。塔维将晴天两个字添在旁边，又将这话照原意记下，没有替它补一个谁都没试过的雨天走法。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , tā zhī xiān gěi sè lā xiě le zhùchù : chuāng cháo nǎbiān , lóuxià kǎobǐng shí wūlǐ zěnme nuǎn , gébì ruǎn héng yèlǐ huì qiāo qiáng bùxǔ chuīshào .
pairs.english: At dusk he first wrote only to Sela about his lodging: where the window faced, how the room warmed when flatbreads baked below, and Ruan Heng next door knocking at night to forbid whistling.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，他只先给瑟拉写了住处：窗朝哪边，楼下烤饼时屋里怎么暖，隔壁阮衡夜里会敲墙不许吹哨。

pairs.target: xiě wán fēng hǎo , fùqián jiāogěi diànlǐ , lìngyìfēng gěi nài lěi de hái liú zhe , děng wǎngfǎn túhuà quán zàijì .
pairs.english: He sealed it and paid the shop to post it. The reply to Nerai remained, waiting until the round-trip drawing was complete.
pairs.hanzi: 写完封好，付钱交给店里，另一封给奈蕾的还留着，等往返图画全再寄。

pairs.target: nà yíyè , tā tīngjiàn yánkǒu luò le jǐshēng qīngqīng de shuǐ , biàn cóng zhěnbiān zuò qǐ , bǎ xiàwǔ tānkāi de zhǐ xiān shōu jìn le gān chù .
pairs.english: That night he heard a few soft drops at the eaves, sat up from his pillow and put the papers spread that afternoon somewhere dry first.
pairs.hanzi: 那一夜，他听见檐口落了几声轻轻的水，便从枕边坐起，把下午摊开的纸先收进了干处。
